corrections: Business began June 1997; listed Cayman company incorporated July 6, 1999. This distinction resolves 1997/1999 founding ambiguity. University archival snippet gives May 1997; adopted direct SEC history June, not snippet.

Corporate biography records director from July 1999, co-CTO July 1999–March 2001, interim CEO July 1999–April 2000, acting CEO/COO June–September 2001 and chief architect March 2001–November 2005. Do not describe CEO tenure as uninterrupted from founding.

November 28, 2005 appointment announcement says effective immediately. SEC covering signature date November 29 is not appointment date. Current group role uses director and CEO, not inferred group chair from a subsidiary biography.

Company biography explicitly uses Bachelor of Science in Communication Technology at UESTC. Chinese secondary descriptions use engineering bachelor. Profile reports a bachelor degree and attributes the English BSc wording. University 1993 graduation search excerpts surfaced, but attempted full pages timed out or did not expose the passage; graduation year and exact specialty are omitted rather than presented as directly verified.
Wikipedia birthday October 1, 1971 conflicts with university archival PDF search excerpt October 10, 1971. PDF open failed 502. Year only retained and no claim full PDF reviewed.

June 30, 2000 Nasdaq ADS listing under NTES and June 11, 2020 Hong Kong ordinary-share listing under 9999 are distinct. Listing dates cross-checked with SEC annual history, not only anticipated dates in pricing announcements.

NetEase Cloud Music launch year 2013 differs from December 2, 2021 subsidiary IPO completion. Group remained controlling shareholder and consolidated it; neither a sale of the entire music business nor the parent’s first listing.

Blizzard renewal statement is April 9 US time / April 10 China time. Timeline uses China date and describes agreement with planned sequential returns from summer 2024, not all games reopening that day. No personal sole authorship of Blizzard games or NetEase titles asserted.

August 20, 2026 announcement contains unaudited second-quarter and first-half results and quotes Ding on original content. Company IR results page returned 403; SEC-filed exhibit was successfully read. No financial numbers repeated without need.
November 5, 2026 signed filing schedules November 19 board meeting and third-quarter results. Future event excluded from completed timeline, but actual signed filing retained as recent evidence.
No current personal fortune, ownership percentage, absolute platform ranking or claims that planned strategies have succeeded. Corporate services and games remain team achievements.
